mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no negative correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are rising, it signals tightening monetary policy amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL rising) does not produce negative returns in > 60% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 300), increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS>4.0 and CPIAUCSL>300), the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300, it signals strong economic expansion and rising consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level shows no positive correlation with 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher retail sales figure (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending supporting corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS level shows no positive correlation with 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor force (PAYEMS) is growing and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) does not produce positive returns in > 60% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
